title: Jane by Design
premise_summary: Jane by Design is an American comedy-drama television series on ABC Family. The series follows the life of Jane Quimby, a teenager who is mistaken for an adult, as she finally gets her fashion dream job working with a world-famous designer, Gray Chandler Murray. She has to juggle between two secret lives: one in high school, and one in high fashion.
